'''Rommi''' was a male [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] living on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] who was a friend of [[Mina Nihrum]]. During the [[raid on Kessan's Landing]] the [[Hidden Chain]] sought to abduct civilians, and Rommi resisted and was [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="TOR" />
